status: User-confirmed Taming Power, direct companion and 32/16/8/8 composition; specific roster and intrinsic limits/body fit remain editable configuration.

confirmed: Tamer has about 64 tameable animals from basic animals through large/cool animals (including Blue Whale and Megalodon) to Mythical Beast. Normal animals considerably outnumber legendary/mythical choices. After the animal spin, directly grant one companion; no taming-success spin.

Tamer wheel composition is exactly 32 current animals, 16 past animals, eight Mythical Beast and eight Pop Culture creatures, with Kyubi as a user example. Total 64 equal outcomes, directly one companion; exact curated identities beyond the examples remain editable.
Tamer explicitly receives Taming Power in addition to its one direct companion. Ordinary owned power uses the one shared Power Mastery and persists after main Power None; no extra power selector.
authority.existingPolicy: Every unspecified wheel uses equal base weights.
authority.authoredChoices: Specific identities within the user-fixed 32/16/8/8 counts are editable curation. Eight Pop Culture suggestions span eight franchises; one-per-franchise is an editorial choice, not a new user rule. One flat equal wheel; no group selector.

contracts.order: Actual Tamer result/reaction -> one Animal To Tame spin -> atomically commit one companion plus fixed Taming Power -> reaction -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: One flat 64-option wheel, equal weight 1, probability 1/64=1.5625% each. User-fixed group counts produce modern 32/64=50%, past 16/64=25%, mythical 8/64=12.5%, Pop Culture 8/64=12.5%. Groups are display metadata only.
contracts.acquisition: Direct one-companion acquisition for every result, including tiny animals. No chance, quantity, subtype, Element or power selector. A generic Dragon/Naga identity stays at this outcome; any future form/capability proposal requires explicit configuration. Named Pop Culture identity also grants only one companion. No automatic evolution, Digivolution, sealing/Jinchuriki, transformation, form or franchise-event branch.
contracts.ownership: Register one separate companion entity, and grant the owner exactly one explicit Taming Power. Companion skills remain separate; no copied race/stat/weapon/mastery/enchant package or additional owner power from companion identity.
contracts.capabilities: Intrinsic companion action/size/habitat/combat profiles remain configuration. Do not copy player-race stat packages, finding rewards or mythology maximum feats. Aquatic companions are not silently made land/flying creatures; presentation placement needs its own profile, not another owner Size spin.
contracts.persistence: Companion and Taming Power survive main Weapon/Power None. Taming Power counts for the one shared ordinary owner Power Mastery. Companion does not itself schedule owner mastery; companion leveling/mastery/bonding wheels remain undefined.
contracts.ledger: Freeze rule/catalog version and animal pool before seeded draw. Commit one companion record and consumed source ledger atomically. Stable instance ID/source key prevent duplicates on retry; replay never redraws the current roster. New 1.2.0 plans freeze the fixed Taming Power reference. Companion and power are one atomic package; old 1.0.0/1.1.0 snapshots retain original companion-only effects without retroactive grant.
contracts.reaction: Actual Animal To Tame result gets its caption/reaction, including Semut/Nyamuk/Kecoa. Caption/fixed acquisition creates no extra funny-result tag or Shrek hook; existing actual tagged-result hooks retain their contracts.
contracts.source: Existing animal/mythical identity refs and primary fauna/franchise sources establish identity/category context only; fantasy companion acquisition and bounded capabilities are game design, not factual domestication or full franchise-feat imports.
